title: Raccoon holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M70 80 Q88 82 90 68 Q92 54 78 54" fill="none" stroke="#8a8fa8" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M82 77 Q85 71 82 66" fill="none" stroke="#5a5f78" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M88 63 Q87 57 83 55" fill="none" stroke="#5a5f78" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="26" ry="20" fill="#8a8fa8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="16" ry="12" fill="#d9dcea"/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="66" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#5a5f78" transform="rotate(-20 35 66)"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="66" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#5a5f78" transform="rotate(20 65 66)"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 62 C46 54 34 54 34 62 C34 68 50 78 50 78 C50 78 66 68 66 62 C66 54 54 54 50 62 Z" fill="#ff5d7a"/>
  <path d="M43 58 Q40 57 40 61" fill="none" stroke="#ffc2ce" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="36" r="11" fill="#5a5f78"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="36" r="11" fill="#5a5f78"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="36" r="5" fill="#c9a0b8"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="36" r="5" fill="#c9a0b8"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="26" fill="#8a8fa8"/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="46" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#5a5f78" transform="rotate(-10 36 46)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="46" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#5a5f78" transform="rotate(10 64 46)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="45" r="5" fill="#e8ecff"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="45" r="5" fill="#e8ecff"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#2a2e45"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#2a2e45"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="44" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="14" ry="9" fill="#e8ecff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3a3f5a"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 58 Q50 63 56 58" fill="none" stroke="#5a5f78" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
